content.short: Calm builds onramp infrastructure for perp DEXs and onchain apps, replacing retail widgets.
content.description: Calm targets perpetuals DEXs and onchain applications specifically, arguing that general-purpose retail onramp widgets fit those flows badly and cost users more than they should. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Trading venues have distinct funding requirements from consumer apps, mostly around speed and the size distribution of deposits.
